state.user_goal: Game-like accessible emergency operations, primary scenario author learns from random incident play. JWE3 strongest reference. Korean, real Busan district openworld, specialist simulation underneath; no draft generator MVP.
source_evidence: JWE3: role-based teams/maintenance and sandbox/challenge; actual-world task visualization.
EMERGENCY20/112Operator: targeted unit dispatch and escalating incidents under resource/traffic constraints.
CoH3/DoorKickers2 official: tactical pause permits analysis/queued orders; frequent actions kept accessible.
Cities/Workers: routing and constrained resource flows create visible delays.
Factorio/RimWorld: delegated execution/priorities reduce repeated micromanagement.
OxygenNotIncluded/Frostpunk: environmental/resource constraints make competing choices legible.
current_code_findings: Only3 fixed destination ids. Right click opens preview/approval modal for move.
Tasks fixed warn->ops,evacuate->fire,medical->medical. Actual actor animation added but task choices remain narrow.
One JPS exit/bottleneck; warn/evac mainly alter desired speed. Medical is request flag. Physics is genuine reference but most user choices cannot change strategy.

candidates.A_direct_command: Field-command RTS: select team/target, contextual orders, tactical pause, short queue, limited teams. Strong immediate agency/observability; risk micro workload.
candidates.B_policy_ops: Priority/zone operations sim: set priorities/areas/resource pools, agents schedule themselves. Lower APM and good systems insight; risk detached dashboard feel.
candidates.C_experiment_sandbox: Scenario/parameter exploration with time scrub and comparison tools. Strong analytical flexibility; risk current non-game experience and long setup.

possible_first_levers.staged_release: Choose all-at-once or staged crowd release/hold using existing walkable geometry; JPS/FDS compute resulting congestion/exposure. Needs explicit cohort control and fair same-seed comparison.
possible_first_levers.reroute_exits: Choose alternate exits/corridors; strongest spatial choice but current one-exit model/geometry must be extended consistently.
possible_first_levers.clinical_model: Add medical physiology engine; closes medical gap but substantial unsupported coupling/validation.
possible_first_levers.more_units: Add more vehicle/unit types first; improves variety but may remain cosmetic.

state.authority: Root synthesizes. Jev critique/rank only; no autonomous acceptance, no code.

primary.instructions: Select strongest primary gameplay identity for explicit user intent.

criteria.A_direct_command: Direct field-command RTS with tactical pause

supporting.instructions: Pick useful secondary layer without displacing primary agency.

criteria.B_policy_ops: Optional priorities/autonomy after basic direct orders

first_lever.instructions: Select first causal gameplay prototype balancing existing model and visible consequence.

criteria.staged_release: Cohort release/hold with actual congestion/exposure tradeoff
criteria.reroute_exits: Extend exits/geometry first for route choice

dominant_risk.instructions: Which current defect most prevents this being a game?

criteria.cosmetic_agency: Commands mostly do not produce strategically distinct model outcomes
criteria.model_count: Number of engines alone is the issue

control.instructions: Choose normal movement interaction for simulation-only game commands.

criteria.context_commit: Right-click/context command is explicit order; validation and undo/cancel feedback in-place
criteria.modal_every_move: Full preview/confirm modal on every move
